params.message:
A source a report cites opens through the launch cover

The links in a report's PDF lead to gentells.com/sources/<key>. A report
is read by people who were never sent a preview link, so every one of
those clicks ended on the holding page. Source pages now pass the cover;
they stay out of search, and the trends, posts and reports they link on
to stay closed.

Portal: Wie in een rapport op een bron klikt, komt nu op de bronpagina uit en niet meer op het wachtscherm.
